scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A worried learner
scenes.caption: In a fictional case, Aman shared a login code with someone claiming to be support. He fears punishment and considers hiding it. His classmate encourages seeking help now.
scenes.dialogue: You deserve help; let us tell an adult.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Limit further harm
scenes.caption: Aman stops replying and sends no more codes. He tells a trusted teacher what happened. The teacher helps the responsible adult use the service’s known account protection and recovery route, rather than following another link supplied by the same contact.
scenes.dialogue: Do not wait for a perfect explanation.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A small factual record
scenes.caption: They write when the message arrived, what action was requested and what Aman shared, without copying the actual secret into their note. Relevant messages can be preserved with adult help. They avoid forwarding private material to classmates or posting accusations publicly.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: The next decision
scenes.caption: A new contact promises guaranteed recovery for a fee. Aman can pay, delete everything, or show the offer to the adult and continue through known official help. Choose the plan that avoids another exposure and preserves useful evidence.
scenes.dialogue: Recovery promises can create another trap.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Appropriate reporting
scenes.caption: The adult checks account sessions and protection options with the provider. If money is involved, they promptly contact their financial provider through its known route and use current official reporting guidance. Nobody can promise recovery, and reporting is not a reason to blame Aman.
scenes.dialogue: Support and factual reporting belong together.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: The situation changes
scenes.caption: The lab adds an unauthorised payment to the timeline. Revise the priorities with adult financial-provider help, keeping the same calm language and minimal incident note. Do not investigate the unknown contact yourselves.
scenes.dialogue: Changed harm needs appropriate help promptly.
